title.zh:
Pi 1.0：搭建自己的
编程工作流
title.en: Pi 1.0: build your own coding workflow

reason.zh: 适合想按自己的方式扩展编程助手的人。
reason.en: For people who want to shape a coding assistant around their own workflow.

title.zh:
NS UI：给 Agent
准备好的组件库
title.en: NS UI: a component registry ready for agents

reason.zh: 适合想让编程助手直接装组件、而不是从零写界面的人。
reason.en: For people who want their coding agent to install real components instead of drawing UI from scratch.

title.zh:
看懂大模型：
拆开 Transformer
title.en: See how an LLM works: open up a Transformer in your browser

reason.zh: 适合想弄明白模型为什么这样回答、又不想先读论文的人。
reason.en: For people who want to see why a model answers the way it does, without reading the paper first.

title.zh:
GPT-6 的回答
开始长出界面
title.en: GPT-6 answers start to come with interfaces

reason.zh: 适合关注 AI 产品形态、想知道“回答即界面”意味着什么的设计师和产品经理。
reason.en: For designers and PMs watching how AI products change when an answer can be an interface.

title.zh:
Refero Styles：
先给助手看规范
title.en: Refero Styles: hand your agent a design brief

reason.zh: 适合想让 AI 做的界面少点“AI 味”的人。
reason.en: For people who want less generic AI-made UI by showing the agent real product specs first.
